locked.constraint: Do not turn the application into a general AI studio or broad plugin marketplace.

locked.decision: Improve, match_reference, and discover task modes
locked.constraint: All three modes appear in the first useful pilot; engine capabilities can be gated separately.

locked.decision: Open portfolio of scoped research tasks
locked.constraint: Projects contain tasks; each task owns sessions, metrics, revisions and evidence.

locked.decision: Use authorized historical successes and failures
locked.constraint: Unknown purchased-product recipes remain unknown; every record does not automatically qualify for training.
Build the useful deterministic/assisted loop before requiring assistant fine-tuning or RL.

locked.decision: Manual approval and laboratory execution initially
locked.constraint: No autonomous physical experiments, dispensing, equipment operation or purchasing.
Do not select a purchased machine or silently send work to cloud.

locked.decision: Cloud fallback with minimized reviewed data
locked.constraint: Local infeasibility plus exact export approval required; aliases do not guarantee secrecy.
Block dependent execution claims only; continue safe synthetic implementation.
Training reward/loss alone cannot promote a model or establish scientific benefit.

engineering_defaults.decision: Modular Python backend plus local browser React UI
engineering_defaults.constraint: Change only through an ADR; standalone does not require a native wrapper.

engineering_defaults.decision: PostgreSQL, private filesystem artifacts, existing PostgreSQL queue
engineering_defaults.constraint: No separate Redis/vector server required for core.
Follow the established canonical IDs/Node/connections/no duplicate cache rules.

engineering_defaults.decision: Loopback single-workspace first; scoped access internally
engineering_defaults.constraint: Team/LAN access requires real auth/TLS/roles; actual assignments unknown.

engineering_defaults.decision: Core installation does not require model/GPU
engineering_defaults.constraint: Profiles independently enabled after capability checks.

engineering_defaults.decision: At most three parallel coding workers initially
engineering_defaults.constraint: Only when tools support delegation and shared contracts are frozen.

engineering_defaults.decision: Latest compatible stable dependencies pinned at bootstrap
engineering_defaults.constraint: No blindly copied stale APIs or unbounded version constraints.

engineering_defaults.decision: Drafts and accepted revisions are separate
engineering_defaults.constraint: Accepted content immutable; corrections create superseding revisions.
